scope: GitLab Ubuntu x86_64 native software execution, source-only model, extracted Studio service and offline command. Does not establish clean-machine platform compatibility, full research quality or production rollout.

evidence.checks: research loop recovery graph/ledger and whole existing offline CI
six-stage research-session integration and full existing offline CI
hardened stage receipt integrity, interruption semantics and full offline CI
canonical registry ref rehash/old-version and fresh-process readback
executable six-stage local-registry research example and negative control
real loopback Studio HTTP/model/public HTTPS fixtures, native Linux package build and manifest verification
all previous plus extracted ZIP real local HTTP server, offline write, persistent conversation/workspace across process restart and session-token rotation
evidence.artifact_claim: job reports successful archive upload; contents not independently downloaded/inspected in this checkpoint

implementation.pipeline_input: Validated spec:inputs.github_sha parameter (lowercase 40-char exact source), no GitHub write credentials; new pipeline accepts override without editing CI YAML
scope_limits: compiled Linux x86_64 C++ binary covers health protocol only
no OS sandbox for approved Python

research_method.observed: actual runner source SHA, job success, scoped artifacts uploaded
alternative_explanations: synthetic inference success is not real-model capability
Ubuntu CI success may not generalize to OCI ARM or Windows/macOS
artifact digest checks cover integrity, not software authenticity or research truth
research_method.falsifier: a clean target OS startup, held-out model tool task or OCI restart failure invalidates release readiness
research_method.counterexample_scope: negative tests, bad manifests, blocked actions, per-process restore
research_method.preservation: no retries for ambiguous external side effects; failed CI logs retained
research_method.next_test: identically checked package on the intended local/OCI host with real model and independent tool task

bias_checks.confirmation: record the unverified model, browser and desktop gates alongside passing tests
bias_checks.selection: distinguish pipeline success from general host acceptance
bias_checks.construct: do not treat synthetic transport as model inference
bias_checks.goodhart: no release badge or task completion from a passing CI job

simplex.reason: no measured convex resource allocation requires simplex geometry

n_ality.rule: axes are recorded separately; a green test is not authority

continuum.reason: no continuous model/precision observable is involved

fuzzy.reason: authentication, checksum and release gates must stay Boolean
